beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt: Classify the request. If it is PRD discovery, PRD note capture, answer to an open PRD question, or informal product clarification, do not block. Treat it as discovery. Writes to docs/prd/notes/ and docs/prd/questions/ are allowed capture artifacts. Apply SISO only for /prd update, PRD.md/state.md/history.md mutations, implementation specs, tickets, architecture for execution, code edits, dependency changes, terminal commands, or other non-capture file mutations.
